about: One-line summaries for evidence-library sources that have no PubMed study line: guidelines, policy, review guidance, registry records, abstracts and local documents. Ids: roadmap:<slug>:<nonpm key> and transplant:<source key>. Each says what the source is and what the page uses it for (at most 160 characters); every number in a line occurs in the source's own citation, note or locator or in the page's own text (tools/test_source_summaries.py). PubMed papers use their compact study line (tools/compact_evidence_source.json). Written 30 October 2026 by Analyst B (Claude.ai) for Hao Liu.

summaries.roadmap:adenoma:generevgsd: GeneReviews entry for glycogen storage disease type I; supplies that condition's imaging intervals in the page's surveillance-by-source table.
summaries.roadmap:adenoma:masterworkup: Local UTHealth/MH draft companion CPG; supplies this page's intake workflow and the hepatic adenoma row of its minimum staging matrix.
summaries.roadmap:adenoma:optn: Allocation policy; cited for adenoma not being a standardized MELD exception and for the extension cycle, as stated in the local protocol, not re-verified.
summaries.roadmap:adenoma:optnnlrb: Review-board guidance, not policy; basis for considering specified high-risk, unresectable or syndromic adenoma at a recommended MMaT-3, nothing automatic.
summaries.roadmap:adenoma:recist: Solid-tumour response criteria; cited only as the source of EASL's 20% diameter growth trigger, which has never been validated in benign liver lesions.
summaries.roadmap:adenoma:uthprotocol: Local UTHealth draft protocol (V3), not final policy; the sole authority for this page's transplant assessment and routes, with VERIFY items still open.
summaries.roadmap:adenoma:who2019: WHO tumour classification; the adenoma subtype and uncertain-malignant-potential nomenclature used by the male adenoma series this page cites.
summaries.roadmap:ampullary:ajcc8: Staging manual; the page's ampulla of Vater TNM, stage groups and grade, taken as reproduced in the NCCN ampullary guideline.
summaries.roadmap:ampullary:cap: Pathology reporting protocol; source of the 1 mm positive-margin definition and the minimum data set NCCN abbreviates; PERIPAN's template is the alternative.
summaries.roadmap:ampullary:nccnamp: US national guideline (unversioned extraction); the page's workup, treatment, adjuvant and surveillance source, with a flagged ESPAC-3 misstatement.
summaries.roadmap:ampullary:nccnpanc: US national guideline for pancreatic cancer; used for the margin, specimen-inking and lymphadenectomy questions ampullary surgery shares with it.
summaries.roadmap:ampullary:periwork: PERIPAN consensus supplement; only its summary tables were used for this draft, and the full document must be read before the page is ratified.
summaries.roadmap:ampullary:who5: WHO tumour classification; the subtype framework PERIPAN refines, consulted through PERIPAN rather than read directly for this draft.
summaries.roadmap:chcca:ajcc8: Staging manual; the page stages combined tumours with the intrahepatic bile duct system, using the tables as reproduced in NCCN Biliary v1.2026.
summaries.roadmap:chcca:localcpg: Local transplant CPG (approved 2022); authority for clinical decision 5 and the transplant structure, flagged as predating WHO 2019 and OPTN guidance.
summaries.roadmap:chcca:nccnbtc: US national guideline; its mixed HCC-CCA and intrahepatic surgery principles and AJCC tables back this page's resection, lymphadenectomy and staging.
summaries.roadmap:chcca:nccnhcc: US national guideline (unversioned extraction); its mixed HCC-CCA, biopsy and pathology principles back resection, transplant referral and first-line therapy.
summaries.roadmap:chcca:optnnlrb: Review-board guidance (9.5.A status unchecked); only policy-side text naming it: unresectable, solitary, biopsy-proven mixed tumour ≤3 cm in cirrhosis, MMaT-3.
summaries.roadmap:chcca:roadmapnone: Page statement, not a source: no MH system roadmap or alignment worksheet exists, so no institutional position outside the transplant assessment.
summaries.roadmap:chcca:trials2026: Registry records read for this page; cited for which cHCC-CCA trials exist, their status and eligibility, not for results.
summaries.roadmap:chcca:who2019: WHO tumour classification; source of the page's definition (one tumour, both differentiations), taken from the editorial board's summary, not the volume.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:ea2222: Registry record of an ongoing US phase III of systemic therapy with or without HAI for unresectable CRLM; cited as a trial option, no results inferred.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:mh-align: Local MH alignment worksheet: sixteen areas where NCCN, IHPBA, OPTN, ASCO and other guidance can disagree, with the local position and open approvals.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:mh-review: Internal MH/UTHealth manuscript draft (V18); the page's clearance, regional-control and remnant-augmentation framework and transplant domains follow it.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:mh-roadmap: Local MH draft roadmap (v0.6), pending approval, not active policy; the document this page is built from for its positions and approval items.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:nccn: US national guideline (Colon v2.2026); this roadmap's NCCN decision rows, including HAI eligibility, SBRT, ablation, resection sequencing and ctDNA.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:optn-guidance: Review-board guidance, not policy; its CRLM section sets the nonstandard MMaT-20 request, CEA limits and renewal rules the transplant decision follows.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:optn-policy: Allocation policy; cited to say CRLM is not a standardized exception and for the Policy 9.4.E score floor applied to review-board requests.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:pump2026: Conference abstract (ASCO 2026); adjuvant HAIP alone after low-risk resection: no significant PFS benefit, OS immature; not routine after low-risk resection.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:tmc24154839: TMC library full-text link to the study showing bevacizumab increases floxuridine HAI biliary toxicity; basis of the no-concurrent-bevacizumab rule.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:tmc24646562: TMC library full-text link to the D’Angelica phase II HAI plus systemic therapy trial, cited for conversion to resection in unresectable CRLM.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:tmc27566258: TMC library full-text link to Cercek's HAI series in chemorefractory CRLM; cited for response, and as not broadening routine eligibility.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:tmc36346892: TMC library full-text link to the HAI pump surgical toolkit; cited with the programme requirements for pump placement and complication management.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:tmc37210451: TMC library full-text link to the single-centre series of liver transplant after HAI pump therapy; supports early technical planning, not a fixed schedule.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:tmc39565488: TMC library full-text link to the Duke expanding-programme HAI series; selected-cohort conversion and complication rates, not institutional targets.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:tmc39962001: TMC library full-text link to the international expert minimum requirements for HAI pump programmes; cited for credentialing the whole service.
summaries.roadmap:crlm:tmcpump2026: TMC library link to the Dutch PUMP conference abstract (ASCO 2026 LBA3506); an abstract, cited for no significant PFS benefit of adjuvant HAIP alone.
summaries.roadmap:hcc:LIRADS: ACR reporting system; this roadmap's ultrasound recall rules and response algorithms, including the radiation algorithm after radioembolisation or SBRT.
summaries.roadmap:hcc:NCCN: US national guideline (HCC v2.2026); quoted by PDF page on referral before biopsy, segmentectomy dosing, Child-Pugh B caution, LEAP-012 and no adjuvant option.
summaries.roadmap:hcc:NCT03778957: EMERALD-1 registry/sponsor disclosure: final OS did not demonstrate a benefit; confirm against the peer-reviewed report; supports the TACE-plus-systemic Avoid.
summaries.roadmap:hcc:NCT04246177: Registry record of LEAP-012 with posted final OS results (no benefit), not peer reviewed; supports the Avoid on TACE plus systemic therapy.
summaries.roadmap:hcc:OPTN9: Allocation policy (9.5 exceptions); cited as binding text that changes without notice, to be re-verified before any criterion is applied to listing.
summaries.roadmap:hilar:align: Local MH alignment worksheet (v0.6): sixteen areas of guideline disagreement, with the institutional position and the proposals flagged for local approval.
summaries.roadmap:hilar:hope4liver: Histotripsy trial one-year update; cited in the histotripsy Avoid row: local control 63.4% primary vs 90% post hoc, no tumour-specific curative evidence.
summaries.roadmap:hilar:nccn: US national guideline (Biliary v1.2026); this page's perihilar pathway, adjuvant and first-line therapy and biomarker positions, cited by PDF page.
summaries.roadmap:hilar:optn: Allocation policy (9.5.A): perihilar CCA is a standardized MELD exception only under an approved centre protocol; the page's transplant conditions follow it.
summaries.roadmap:hilar:optnnlrb: Review-board guidance, not policy; cited to note it has no perihilar section, as this diagnosis is handled in OPTN policy instead.
summaries.roadmap:hilar:roadmap: Local MH draft roadmap (v0.6), pending approval, not active policy; the document this page transcribes for its decisions and approval items.
summaries.roadmap:hilar:swog0809: Single-arm phase II trial of adjuvant chemotherapy then chemoradiation; cited as BSG's support for R1 chemoradiation, with no control arm.
summaries.roadmap:hilar:uthprotocol: Local UTHealth transplant protocol (v2); the internal document behind the roadmap's corrected allocation statement, read with OPTN Policy 9.5.A.
summaries.roadmap:icca:capicca: Pathology reporting protocol (CAP v4.3.0.0); its AJCC8 pT categories and tumour-focality definitions underpin the page's nodule-description standard.
summaries.roadmap:icca:hope4liver: Histotripsy trial one-year update in HCC and metastases, not iCCA; cited only to keep histotripsy protocol-only (63.4% primary vs 90% post hoc control).
summaries.roadmap:icca:mhalign: Local MH alignment worksheet: 16 areas where guidelines disagree, including the one place the roadmap departs from NCCN, on liver-directed therapy alone.
summaries.roadmap:icca:mhroadmap: Local MH draft roadmap (v0.6), pending approval, not active policy; the source of the institutional positions this page transcribes.
summaries.roadmap:icca:nccn: US national guideline (Biliary v1.2026); this page's diagnosis, staging, molecular profiling, resection and systemic-therapy rows, by algorithm page.
summaries.roadmap:icca:optn: Allocation policy; cited to say iCCA is not a standardized MELD exception, so every request is a review-board narrative at MMaT-3.
summaries.roadmap:icca:optnguid: Review-board guidance, not policy or a clinical guideline; defines the narrow iCCA transplant phenotype and MMaT-3 route in clinical decision 10.
summaries.roadmap:icca:rcpafocality: Structured pathology reporting standard (RCPA); cited for the point that iCCA has no clear universal satellite-nodule definition.
summaries.roadmap:icca:tmc24154839: TMC library full-text link to the study showing bevacizumab increases floxuridine HAI biliary toxicity; basis of the no-concurrent-bevacizumab rule.
summaries.roadmap:icca:tmc36346892: TMC library full-text link to the HAI pump surgical toolkit; cited with the programme requirements for pump placement and complication management.
summaries.roadmap:icca:tmc39962001: TMC library full-text link to the international expert minimum requirements for HAI pump programmes; cited for credentialing the whole service.
summaries.roadmap:icca:tmc41082695: TMC library full-text link to PUMP-2, the nonrandomized phase II HAI trial in unresectable iCCA, cited for response, resection and survival.
summaries.roadmap:icca:tmc42331230: TMC library full-text link to the pooled four-trial HAI analysis in iCCA; the page warns the cohorts overlap and are not independent replication.
summaries.roadmap:incidental:acrac: ACR appropriateness ratings (2020, read as Chernyak 2020); the page's imaging choices for indeterminate lesions by size, cancer history and liver disease.
summaries.roadmap:incidental:acrif: ACR committee listing; cited to show the 2017 liver incidental-findings white paper has not been revised, so the page still relies on it.
summaries.roadmap:incidental:ceuslirads: ACR reporting system for contrast ultrasound (v2017); cited as current but a version behind CT/MRI LI-RADS, with categories not interchangeable.
summaries.roadmap:incidental:lirads2018: ACR reporting system (CT/MRI v2018, still current); the at-risk-liver categories, major features and management recommendations this page quotes.
summaries.roadmap:incidental:masterworkup: Local UTHealth/MH draft CPG; the page's safety screen, central review, staging bundles, dispositions and the perihilar no-biopsy rule.
summaries.roadmap:nelm:asco25: ASCO guideline on symptom management in well-differentiated GEP-NETs; listed among this page's guideline documents, read outside the paper depot.
summaries.roadmap:nelm:hope4liver: Histotripsy trial one-year update (mixed histology); cited to keep histotripsy trial- or registry-only (63.4% primary vs 90% post hoc local control).
summaries.roadmap:nelm:mh-align: Local MH alignment worksheet: sixteen areas comparing the roadmap with NCCN, NANETS, ENETS and OPTN guidance, with open local approval items.
summaries.roadmap:nelm:mh-roadmap: Local MH draft roadmap (v0.6), systemwide review copy pending approval; the document this page is built from for its positions.
summaries.roadmap:nelm:nccn: US national guideline (NE v1.2026); the page's imaging, surgery and carcinoid-crisis, pathology, embolisation, PRRT and transplant positions, by PDF page.
summaries.roadmap:nelm:optn-nlrb: Review-board guidance, not policy; sets the nonstandard MMaT-3 NELM route and imaging-timing rules, and states no age or hepatic-burden cutoff.
summaries.roadmap:nelm:optn9: Allocation policy; cited because NELM is not a standardized exception, and for the MMaT score floor under Policy 9.4.E and 90-day extensions.
summaries.roadmap:pcyst:euro2013: Superseded 2013 European consensus; listed because NCCN cites it, so a reader following NCCN reaches thresholds the 2018 guideline replaced.
summaries.roadmap:pcyst:kyotopdf: Full text of the Kyoto 2024 IPMN guidelines, read in full; the page's high-risk and worrisome features, surveillance, discontinuation and remnant rules.
summaries.roadmap:pcyst:nccn: US national guideline with no cyst algorithm; cited for its summary of Kyoto and a superseded European statement, and for its IPMN and MCN resection rules.
summaries.roadmap:pcyst:who2019: WHO tumour classification; the cyst entity definitions and two-tier dysplasia grading this page uses, not re-verified against the current online edition.
summaries.roadmap:pdac:a021806: Registry record of a phase III of perioperative versus adjuvant chemotherapy, active and not recruiting; no results posted, cited only as an open question.
summaries.roadmap:pdac:cap: Pathology protocol, cited through NCCN for the 1 mm positive-margin rule and millimetre clearance reporting; current version still to be confirmed.
summaries.roadmap:pdac:conko004: Randomised enoxaparin trial via NCCN text only: fewer symptomatic VTE, no survival effect, so NCCN does not recommend routine LMWH prophylaxis.
summaries.roadmap:pdac:espac3: Secondary ESPAC-3 analysis via NCCN text only: completing adjuvant chemotherapy, not start time, predicted survival; open to obvious confounding.
summaries.roadmap:pdac:isgps: ISGPS consensus statement read from the abstract only; source of the standard lymphadenectomy definition, so the surgery item it supports is graded C.
summaries.roadmap:pdac:nccn: US national guideline (unversioned extraction); the page's workup, resectability, neoadjuvant, pathology, systemic, radiation and supportive-care source.
summaries.roadmap:pdac:paxg: Randomised phase 3 of PAXG versus mFOLFIRINOX, via NCCN text only: longer event-free survival; NCCN lists it as useful in certain circumstances.
summaries.roadmap:pdac:rtog0848: Randomised adjuvant chemoradiation trial, via NCCN text only: benefit in node-negative, none in node-positive patients; primary paper not read.
summaries.roadmap:pnet:firstdraft: Page statement, not a source: no MH roadmap or alignment worksheet exists for PNET, so nothing here is an institutional decision.
summaries.roadmap:pnet:fulltext: Page method note: 28 of 33 papers read in full and abstracted; names the guidance still cited from programme copies or abstracts only.
summaries.roadmap:pnet:nccn: US national guideline (unversioned extraction); the page's diagnosis, functioning and nonfunctioning tumour, pathology, surgery, systemic and MEN1 content.
summaries.roadmap:pnet:nct05040360: Registry record of an ongoing randomised trial of chemotherapy after PNET resection; the destination for patients wanting adjuvant therapy, not for results.
summaries.roadmap:pnet:nelm: Local MH NELM roadmap (draft v0.6) as rendered on its pathway page; the destination for any patient here who develops or presents with liver metastases.
summaries.roadmap:pnet:who2019: WHO digestive tumour classification; the NET grading criteria on this page, taken from the table NCCN reproduces with permission.
summaries.transplant:H-policy: Allocation policy (OPTN 9.5.I): the standardized HCC exception's Class 5 burden, AFP and imaging rules applied here; it sets eligibility, not best treatment.
summaries.transplant:I-focality: Pathology protocol (CAP v4.3.0.0); its AJCC8 pT and focality definitions set how confirmed satellite and other iCCA nodules are counted at selection.
summaries.transplant:I-satellites: Structured reporting standard (RCPA); cited for the point that iCCA has no clear universal satellite definition when nodules are counted.
summaries.transplant:N-crlm: Review-board guidance, not policy; CRLM steps follow it as nonstandard review, not automatic; its >10% progression footnote differs from usual RECIST 1.1.
summaries.transplant:N-hca: Review-board guidance, not policy, for hepatic adenoma; its alternative review routes structure the exception-route, review and follow-up steps.
summaries.transplant:N-hcc: Review-board guidance for HCC, not policy; used for contraindications, beyond-criteria downstaging, imaging timing and individual exception review.
summaries.transplant:N-hehe: Review-board guidance, not policy, for hepatic epithelioid hemangioendothelioma; used at each step from diagnosis and staging to submission.
summaries.transplant:N-icca: Review-board guidance, not policy, for iCCA and mixed HCC-iCCA; the basis of each step from histology and selection to stability and the exception request.
summaries.transplant:N-net: Review-board guidance, not policy, for NET liver metastases; the basis of each step from grade and primary treatment to disease control and renewal.
summaries.transplant:NCCN-crlm: US national guideline (Colon v2.2026, COL-D); cited for continuing colorectal cancer care and supportive care when transplant is unsuitable.
summaries.transplant:NCCN-hcc: US national guideline (HCC v2.2026); cited for treatment reassessment and local, systemic, resection and supportive options when the transplant plan changes.
summaries.transplant:NCCN-icca: US national guideline (Biliary v1.2026, INTRA-1); cited for iCCA treatment and supportive care when transplant criteria are not met.
summaries.transplant:NCCN-net: US national guideline (NET v1.2026); cited for continuing NET treatment and symptom-focused supportive care when transplant is unsuitable.
summaries.transplant:NCCN-pcca: US national guideline (Biliary v1.2026, EXTRA-1); cited for treatment and supportive care when the pCCA transplant protocol is unsuitable.
summaries.transplant:NCI-support: NCI fact sheet on palliative care in cancer; supports each pathway's best supportive care plan and that palliative care can accompany treatment.
summaries.transplant:P-policy: Allocation policy (OPTN 9.5.A): the hilar CCA exception (approved center protocol, neoadjuvant therapy, operative staging, mass <3 cm) applied at each step.
summaries.transplant:crlm_seca3: Registry record of the Oslo SECA-III randomized trial; cited only for its eligibility wording on prior extrahepatic disease; recruiting, no results posted.
summaries.transplant:nlrb: Review-board guidance, not policy; the high-risk reviews quote its diagnosis-specific criteria as nonbinding allocation guidance, with no outcome data.
summaries.transplant:optn: Binding OPTN policy (allocation and living donation); the high-risk reviews cite it to keep allocation, donor protection and reporting duties separate.
